settings.title: Spray Tan
settings.description: Achieve a flawless, natural-looking glow every time. Choose from subtle sun-kissed tones to a deep, bronzed radiance — custom colour selection and professional application for even, streak-free results.

settings.title: Special Occasion Makeup
settings.description: Perfect for formals, engagements, birthdays, or a night out. Receive a polished, camera-ready look tailored to your features and outfit, including skin prep and false lashes for a long-lasting finish.

settings.heading: Your Appointment
settings.lede: How to prepare, what happens in the chair, how to keep the colour — and the deposit and cancellation terms that hold your time.

settings.heading: Before Your Tan
settings.items:
- Exfoliate the day before, and skip oil-based scrubs.
- Shave or wax at least 24 hours ahead so pores have settled.
- Arrive with clean skin: no moisturiser, deodorant, makeup or perfume.
- Have nails, waxing and facials done beforehand, not after.
- Bring loose, dark clothing and open shoes to change into.

settings.heading: During Your Appointment
settings.items:
- Your shade is mixed to suit your skin tone and how deep you want to go.
- Applied with a professional spray system in a private room.
- Disposables provided; you wear whatever you are comfortable in.
- Around fifteen minutes start to finish, so it fits into a lunch break.

settings.heading: After Your Tan
settings.items:
- Leave the tan to develop for the time agreed at your appointment before you rinse.
- Rinse in cool water without soap, then pat dry rather than rubbing.
- Moisturise daily — hydrated skin holds colour noticeably longer.
- Skip long hot showers, chlorine, saunas and heavy exercise while it settles.
- Expect roughly five to seven days of colour, fading evenly.

settings.heading: Timing Your Tan
settings.items:
- Book one to two days before the event so the colour has time to settle.
- Tan first, makeup after — the two are never done in the same appointment.
- If it is your first tan before a big day, allow a practice run.
- Travelling in for the occasion? Tell us and we will plan the timing around you.

settings.heading: Deposits & Payments
settings.items:
- Spray tan: full payment of $50 is required to book.
- Special occasion makeup: $100 deposit at booking; the remaining $100 is payable in studio on the day.
- Bookings open up to 4 months in advance.

settings.heading: Cancellations & Credits
settings.items:
- Cancel at least 72 hours before the appointment and the payment or deposit becomes a credit, valid for 12 months.
- Cancellations within 72 hours forfeit the payment or deposit.
- Exceptions for documented emergencies can be considered at our discretion.

settings.question: How long does a spray tan last?
settings.answer: Around five to seven days for most people. How you prepare and how you look after it makes more difference than anything else — exfoliating beforehand and moisturising daily afterwards is what keeps it fading evenly rather than patchily.

settings.question: Will it look orange?
settings.answer: No. The solution is mixed to your skin tone and to the depth you have asked for, rather than poured from a one-size bottle. If you are unsure, start lighter — it is easy to go deeper next time, and a first tan is a good chance to see how your skin takes the colour.

settings.question: What should I wear to the appointment?
settings.answer: Loose, dark clothing and open shoes, so nothing rubs against the tan while it develops. Avoid tight straps, denim and anything you would be upset to see a mark on. Disposables are provided for the appointment itself.

settings.question: When can I shower?
settings.answer: Wait for the development time agreed at your appointment — it depends on the depth you have chosen. Then rinse in cool water without soap and pat dry. The water will run brown; that is the cosmetic bronzer washing off, not the tan.

settings.question: How soon before my event should I book?
settings.answer: One to two days ahead is the sweet spot. Same-day tanning does not leave room for the colour to settle, and any earlier than three days means you lose some of the peak. Tell us the date of the event and we will work backwards from it.

settings.question: Can you tan a group, or come to us?
settings.answer: Send an enquiry with the date, the number of people and the location. Group bookings for a wedding party, a formal or a birthday are quoted individually so the timing works for everyone.
